name: proposal-research
description: Multi-agent web research for product and solution proposals. Six subagents communicate through append-only claim ledgers; one PostToolUse hook records every fetch with its originating agent_id, and two PreToolUse hooks keep the ledgers append-only and keep the validator blind; a blocking gate proves citation provenance and validator independence before a proposal is drafted. Emits a self-contained Obsidian vault per run.
